# NGAP PDUs of one UE registration and PDU session set-up, as captured on N2 between a simulated gNB (UERANSIM) and a
# 5G core AMF in a lab network (PLMN 999/70, test SUPI), 2025-02-12. Fourteen PDUs: NG Setup, Initial UE Message,
# NAS transport, Initial Context Setup, PDU Session Resource Setup. `->` is gNB to AMF, `<-` AMF to gNB.
# The capture is 5g_attach.pcap next to this file (published with the owner's agreement; the AMF name was replaced by a
# text of the same length and the SCTP checksum of that packet recomputed; nothing else is changed). This file is
#   python3 -I tools/extract_pcap_ngap.py crates/onwai-ngap/tests/captures/5g_attach.pcap \
#       --replace 64.23.237.161=192.0.2.1 --replace 137.184.184.232=192.0.2.2
# i.e. the PDUs with the two public N3 addresses swapped for documentation addresses, so the tests do not depend on them.
# `<frame>.<n> <direction> | <hex of the complete NGAP-PDU>`
